title: HSK2 Gate 15 · Southern Song
explanationEn: Gate 15: Southern Song. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第15关：南宋。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 中国人很早就开始喝茶了。到了宋朝，喝茶已经是每天的事。茶是用山上一种树上的东西做的。要先把它放到外面的光下面。
passageEn: Chinese people began drinking tea very early. By the Song, tea was an everyday thing. Tea is made from something that grows on a plant in the hills. It must first be laid out in the light outside.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Chinese people began drinking tea very early.
comprehension.answer: 中国人很早就开始喝茶了。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Tea is made from something that grows on a plant in the hills.
comprehension.answer: 茶是用山上一种树上的东西做的。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 人 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“人”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 人 (rén) means "person" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “人”（rén）的意思是“person”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 早 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“早”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 早 (zǎo) means "early; morning" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “早”（zǎo）的意思是“early; morning”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 中国人很早就开始喝茶了。

options.text: Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
Chinese people began drinking tea very early.

check.explanationEn: "中国人很早就开始喝茶了。" means "Chinese people began drinking tea very early.".
check.explanation: “中国人很早就开始喝茶了。”的意思是“Chinese people began drinking tea very early.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Southern Song in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说南宋。
